title: Update Client Settings Response
description: The client's updated settings for using payment agents.

data.description: The client's updated settings for using payment agents.

deposit_enabled.description: Whether the client can currently receive deposits from payment agents (that is, be the recipient of a transfer).

withdraw_enabled.description: Whether the client can currently withdraw funds through a payment agent.

show_real_name.description: Whether payment agents see the client's real name on transactions. `false` withholds the real name.

metadata.description: Request metadata included in every response.

method.description: The HTTP method used for the request.

timing.description: Time in seconds for the service to process the request.
